title: Conveyor
description: A conveyor camera treats the world as a belt: relentless lateral travel at constant speed, factory or infinite product-line geometry. The subject can stand still while the line delivers the next unit past the frame.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Industry, process, no escape from the line. The shot says labor is a machine: bodies, boxes, or faces arrive and leave at one speed.
Comedy and paranoia both live here. It is the wrong tool for a walker you are meant to accompany.
If the person is choosing a path, truck or track with them. A conveyor that speeds up and slows with emotion is no longer a belt.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Lateral dolly, slider, or a treadmill-like set, constant velocity, often a wide or moderate-wide so units repeat. Foreground machinery should cross faster than the far wall.

Exposure can be industrial: hard practicals, green or sodium, no beauty key. Prompt: Conveyor move past [Subject], the world sliding on a belt, factory or infinite product line, relentless lateral travel.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it for a factory, an assembly of faces, a process that will not stop. Do not use it beside a casual sidewalk chat.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a trucking shot with a walker. The tell: the subject is strolling and the camera is being polite.
The fix: constant lateral speed, repeating units, the person as another item on the line.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Conveyor in film?
A conveyor camera is relentless lateral travel at constant speed, as if the world were a factory belt. The subject can be still while units keep arriving.
Conveyor vs Trucking
Trucking stays beside a person walking. Conveyor is industrial: one speed, repeating units, process without escape.
When should I use Conveyor?
Use it for factories, process, and systems that swallow people. Do not use it for a casual walk-and-talk.
How do I prompt Conveyor for AI image or video?
Write constant lateral speed and a belt or product line. Example: Conveyor move past [Subject], the world sliding on a belt, factory or infinite product line, relentless lateral travel.
